body.translated_text: <s>Ahorātravratakathā</s> (The Story of the Day-and-Night Observance)
Avk_P_1. Oṃ, obeisance to the <s>Dharmadhātu</s> (realm of truth)!

children.translated_text: Pure as the sky, free from elaboration, the abode of qualities,
peaceful, consisting of the five <s>skandhas</s> (aggregates) — obeisance to that one whose nature is the <s>stūpa</s>! ||1||

body.text: ekasminn antare kāle bhagavān kapilavastuni mahānagare viha

children.text: ti sma sārdhaṃ pañcamātrair bhikṣuśataiḥ sa
children.translated_text: ing in the great city of <s>Kapilavastu</s>, together with five hundred <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks),

children.text: bahulaiś ca kṛtakṛtyair jitendriyaiḥ kṣīṇāsravair anyaiś ca bodhisattvaśataiḥ ṣaṭpāramitānirjātaiḥ pañcacakṣusamanvāgatair anekaiḥ śrāvakamukhyair anuttarapuṇyakṣetre nivāsitair buddhaśāsanaratibhir anekair devanāgayakṣādibhiḥ parimaṇḍitaiḥ sapārṣadaparipūrṇaiḥ /
children.translated_text: long with many who had accomplished their purpose, who had conquered their senses, whose impurities were exhausted, and with hundreds of other <s>Bodhisattvas</s> who had perfected the six <s>pāramitās</s> (perfections), endowed with the five eyes, with many chief <s>Śrāvakas</s> (disciples) dwelling in the supreme field of merit, devoted to the <s>Buddha</s>'s teaching, adorned by many gods, <s>nāgas</s>, <s>yakṣas</s>, and others, with a full assembly and retinue.

body.translated_text: At one time, the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One) was dwel-

children.text: adhara śrīmān muniśārdūlas tatsabhāyām anekadevanāgayakṣādisaṃmilite naikagiram ājñāṃ nāvabhāṣitaṃ kim / kimabhilāṣo bhavasi subhūte yathābhiprāyas tathā vijñāpaya śākyamunau / subhūtir āha / narāṇām uttamaṃ vrataṃ yad ahorātravrataṃ vratarāja
children.translated_text: adhara, the illustrious lion among sages — in that assembly gathered with many gods, <s>nāgas</s>, <s>yakṣas</s>, and others — has not uttered a single word or command. What is [the reason]? What do you desire, <s>Subhūti</s>? State your wish as your intention is before <s>Śākyamuni</s>. <s>Subhūti</s> said: The supreme among observances for humans — the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (Day-and-Night Observance), the king of vows,

children.text: mahodayaṃ mamābhilāṣaḥ / ity ukte mahānumataṃ sādaraṃ kṛtvā vaj
children.translated_text: great festival — that is my desire. When this was said, [<s>Subhūti</s>], having shown great approval and respect, <s>Vaj-</s>

children.text: adharo bhagavantam evam āha / bhagavan muniśārdūla giram ekam api nāvabhāṣitam / sarvasabhājanānām abhilaṣitaṃ subhūtir iti vratarāja
children.translated_text: adhara spoke thus to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: O <s>Bhagavān</s>, lion among sages, you have not uttered even a single word. What all the assembly desires — <s>Subhūti</s> [has expressed it] — the king of vows,

children.text: mahodayaṃ yad ahorātravratopāyikām abhilāṣiko 'ham ity āha / tat sakalaṃ prabhāṣaya tvaṃ munīśvara /
children.translated_text: great festival, the means of the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> — 'I desire this,' he has said. Therefore, declare it fully, O lord of sages!

body.translated_text: Avk_P_2. In that assembly, <s>Subhūti</s>

body.text: Avk_P_3. bhagavān āha / sādhu sādhu vaj

children.text: adhara lokānāṃ hitahetunā pṛcchitaṃ saphalaṃ pūrayāmi / ity uktvā śrīdharmadhātusamādhau sthitavān /
children.translated_text: adhara! What you have asked for the benefit of the world, I shall fulfill fruitfully. Having said this, he entered the <s>Śrī-dharmadhātu-samādhi</s> (concentration on the glorious realm of truth).

body.translated_text: Avk_P_3. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: Well done, well done, O <s>Vaj-</s>

children.translated_text: On a great lotus at the tip of his nose, a flame of <s>Dharma</s> blazing brilliantly,
illuminating all the directions, he shone in that assembly. ||2||

body.text: tadā sarvaparṣadajanāḥ ke cit paraṃ dharmasubhāṣitaṃ ke cid bhagavato vaco'mṛtakaṃ pātum ... / tathaivānye kathā

children.translated_text: exchanged among themselves. Those members of the assembly [said]:

children.text: sādhu bhagavadraśmayaḥ prādurbhūtā avaśyaṃ dharmakathāṃ pratibhāṣayiṣyati /
children.translated_text: Excellent! The rays of the <s>Bhagavān</s> have appeared; he will surely deliver a <s>Dharma</s> discourse!"

body.translated_text: Then all the members of the assembly — some [awaiting] the excellent discourse of <s>Dharma</s>, some [wishing] to drink the nectar-like words of the <s>Bhagavān</s>... And similarly, other conversations

children.text: adharaḥ punar apy uvāca / sādhu bhagavan mahāprabha kasmin bhagava
children.translated_text: adhara spoke again: Excellent, O <s>Bhagavān</s> of great radiance! On which

children.text: pṛthivyāṃ kena saṃcāritam ahorātravrataṃ brūhi me parameśvara / bhagavān āha / śṛṇu vaj
children.translated_text: earth, by whom was the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> (Day-and-Night Observance) first practiced? Tell me, O supreme lord! The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: Listen, O <s>Vaj-</s>

children.text: adhara mahātejaṃ vratānām uttamaṃ vrataṃ pṛthivyāṃ pāvanīkathām /
children.translated_text: adhara! [I shall tell you] the supreme observance among vows, of great splendor — the purifying story [of its practice] on earth.

body.translated_text: Avk_P_4. Then <s>Vaj-</s>

body.text: Avk_P_5. purātanīkāle uttaradigbhāge dharmapattano nāma mahānagarī āsīd maghavatpattanasamā sujana-m-uttamaiḥ paripūritā / kathaṃ vistāritā nagarī / saptayojanasaṃvṛtā vyāyāmavistīrṇā bhavati .... tālapaṅktibhiḥ parikhābhiś ca parirundhyamānā mahotsavā / tadūrdhvaṃ trikūṭaparvato 'sti / nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇaṃ nānāpakṣigaṇasadārataṃ nānākusumasugandhavāsitam anekarṣibhiḥ suvāsitaṃ trikūṭam eva / anekaśūrasamākīrṇānekavidvajjanāvṛtā nānāśilpajñasamāpannā bhiṣagvaraprabhṛtinānāsupuruṣaparipūrṇā bhavati nagarī kālavedīkālajñasamayajñacaittajñamantrīsamāpannā ca /
body.translated_text: Avk_P_5. In ancient times, in the northern direction, there was a great city named <s>Dharmapattana</s> (City of Dharma), equal to the city of <s>Maghavat</s> (<s>Indra</s>), filled with the best of good people. How vast was the city? It was seven <s>yojanas</s> in circumference, wide in extent... surrounded by rows of palm trees and moats, [the site of] great festivals. Above it stands <s>Trikūṭa</s> mountain, covered with various trees, delighting with flocks of various birds, fragrant with the scent of various flowers, well-perfumed by many <s>ṛṣis</s> (sages) — such was <s>Trikūṭa</s>. The city was filled with many warriors, surrounded by many learned people, endowed with those skilled in various crafts, complete with the best physicians and many excellent men, and equipped with astrologers, time-knowers, occasion-knowers, mind-knowers, and counselors.

body.text: Avk_P_6. tasyāṃ nagaryāṃ dharmadakṣo nāma rājā babhūva nayavinayavivekavidhijñaḥ prajāvatsalasvabhāvaḥ paraduḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā svātmani vedanīyo dayāvān dharmatrāṇadharmaparāyaṇa

children.text: / tasya patnī suvratī sadā dharmacāriṇī vidyāguṇasaṃpannā /
children.translated_text: His wife, <s>Suvratī</s> (Of Good Vows), was always practicing <s>Dharma</s>, endowed with learning and virtue.

body.translated_text: Avk_P_6. In that city there was a king named <s>Dharmadakṣa</s> (Skilled in Dharma), knowledgeable in policy, humility, discrimination, and ritual, of a nature loving toward his subjects, compassionate — feeling others' suffering and happiness as his own — devoted to <s>Dharma</s>'s protection and committed to <s>Dharma</s>,

body.text: Avk_P_7. atha tasmin samaye tatra trikūṭaparvate śāriputro nāma mahātmāyuṣmān jainajño buddhajñānavidāṃ varo viharati / tadā śāriputro 'nuvicintayati / ko dharmavatsalo dharmaparāyaṇo dharmacaraṇo 'sti kasminn iti / ta

children.text: kṣaṇāt smṛtya darśitam ity uktam / darśito dharmacaraṇo dharmavatsalo dharmaparāyaṇo dharmadakṣo nāma rājā asti / taṃ dharma
children.translated_text: that very instant, it was revealed through recollection, and it was said: 'It is shown — there is a king named <s>Dharmadakṣa</s> who practices <s>Dharma</s>, is devoted to <s>Dharma</s>, and committed to <s>Dharma</s>. To him I shall teach the <s>Dharma</s>
Having said this, he went to the great city of <s>Dharmapattana</s>

children.text: / tatra prāsāda-m-ekam asti / tasmin tiṣṭhati / sa tato 'nekadharmakathanena sthitavān / taṃ sarvajanā
children.translated_text: There stood a certain palace. He stayed there. Through the narration of many <s>dharma</s> teachings he remained. All the people
in the palace gave him acclaim. Then

body.translated_text: Avk_P_7. Now at that time, on <s>Trikūṭa</s> mountain, the great and venerable one named <s>Śāriputra</s>, knower of <s>Jaina</s> [doctrine] and foremost among those who know the <s>Buddha</s>'s wisdom, was dwelling. Then <s>Śāriputra</s> reflected: 'Who is devoted to <s>Dharma</s>, committed to <s>Dharma</s>, practicing <s>Dharma</s> — and where?'

body.text: Avk_P_8. atha dharmadakṣo mahārājā sarvavṛttāntam anumataṃ śrutvā

children.text: vicāram ādareṇa sagauraveṇa mahotsavena rājakule praveśayati vāsanabhaktena pratiṣṭhāpayati / atha śāriputro rājānam āśīrvacanam abravīt / saddharma
children.translated_text: with deliberation, with respect, with reverence, and with great celebration, brought [<s>Śāriputra</s>] into the royal palace and established him with lodging and food. Then <s>Śāriputra</s> spoke a blessing to the king: 'May the true <s>Dharma</s>
practiced, O child! May the true <s>Dharma</s>

children.text: kurutāṃ mokṣaṃ sarvakāmā bhavantu vaḥ / atha sa rājā praharṣeṇa āśīrvacanam āka
children.translated_text: practiced! May liberation [come]! May all your desires be fulfilled!' Then that king, with great joy, upon hea-

children.text: ṇya śāriputram evam āha / vibho śāriputra katham āśīrvacanaṃ tava / kaś ci
children.translated_text: ing the blessing, spoke thus to <s>Śāriputra</s>: O reverend <s>Śāriputra</s>, what is this blessing of yours? Would some

children.text: buddho vā devo vā devī vā maheśvaro
children.translated_text: or a god, or a goddess, or <s>Maheśvara</s>,

children.text: tām iti dadāsi / saddharmaṃ na jānāmi bhagavan saddharmaṃ bhāṣatu mahāmate /
children.translated_text: ced!' I do not know the true <s>Dharma</s>, O <s>Bhagavān</s>! Please explain the true <s>Dharma</s>, O great wise one!

body.translated_text: Avk_P_8. Then the great king <s>Dharmadakṣa</s>, having heard and approved of the entire account,
Avk_P_9. <s>Śāriputra</s> said:

body.text:
na jānāsi maharaja dharmāṇāṃ dharmam uttamam /
dharmadhātu

children.translated_text: how [can it be described]? The name '<s>Dharma</s>' is the best mine [of virtues]. ||3||

body.translated_text: You do not know, O great king, the supreme <s>dharma</s> among <s>dharmas</s>! The <s>Dharmadhātu</s>

body.text: śṛṇu rājan mahāteja prathamato dharmadhātuprasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā ahorātravrataṃ kāraye

children.text: / atha cāśrame vā nagare vihāre vā anye vā yatra dharmadhātur asti tatrāhorātravrataṃ kuryāt / aharniśam ahorātraṃ saddharmaṃ tad vratam iti purā tathāgataiḥ /
children.translated_text: And whether in a hermitage, or in a city, or in a monastery, or elsewhere — wherever a <s>Dharmadhātu</s> [shrine] exists, there one should perform the <s>Ahorātravrata</s>. Day and night — the day-and-night [observance] is the true <s>Dharma</s>; that is the vow — so [declared] formerly by the <s>Tathāgatas</s>.

body.translated_text: Listen, O king of great splendor! First, having performed the consecration of the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>, one should perform the <s>Ahorātravrata</s>
Avk_P_10. The king said:

body.text:
kathaṃ vidhividhānādīn kathyatāṃ bhikṣusattama /
vratarājaṃ tu saṃsāre dinamāsādikaṃ
body.translated_text: How are the various rites and procedures to be described, O best of <s>bhikṣus</s>? The king of vows in <s>saṃsāra</s> — by day, month, and so forth,

children.translated_text: the installation of the four deities, beginning with the <s>Dharmadhātu</s>.

children.text: catasradevatāsthāpanaṃ dharmadhātuprabhṛtasya / icchanti ye sattvā brahmakṣatri

children.translated_text: s, <s>Vaiśyas</s>, <s>Śūdras</s>, and others — should perform the four-caste vow.
others are qualified each according to their own suitability.

body.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s> said: First, O great king, one should perform the establishment of barley-water

body.text: Avk_P_11. rājan māsāśvinīśuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ dantadhāvanaṃ kuryā

children.translated_text: [One should perform] shaving, purification, and bathing; at midday one should make gift-offerings

children.text: / tataḥ sūrye ṣaṣṭe gate śālyodanaṃ bhojanaṃ kuryā
children.translated_text: Then, when the sun has reached the sixth [hour], one should eat a meal of rice

children.text: / tato mukhaprakṣālanaṃ ...... paścāt / tadā vyākhyānaṃ śṛṇuyāt tataḥ / rātrau trayārdhaprahare rājan sarve samutthāya pratyūṣavelāyāṃ snātvā kriyākāraṃ kṛtvā śucivastraṃ prāvṛtya vrataṃ kuryā
children.translated_text: Then, rinsing the mouth...... afterward. Then one should listen to discourse. At night, at three and a half <s>praharas</s> (watches), O king, all should rise, and at the dawn-hour, having bathed, performed the ritual, and donned clean garments, one should undertake the vow
Having made a <s>maṇḍala</s> (ritual diagram) of the five deities, having smeared [the ground] with unfallen cow-dung, and having offered <s>arghya</s> (ritual offering),

children.text: tūpāya puṣpadhūpadīpagandhanaivedyavīṇāvaṃśamṛdaṅgamurajapaṭahatālaśaṅkhadhvajacchattragītanṛtyādīn ṣoḍaśavidhim arcanai rājan nānotsavaprapūritaiḥ prathame pañcapradakṣiṇaṃ kāraye
children.translated_text: the <s>stūpa</s> — with flowers, incense, lamps, fragrance, food-offerings, <s>vīṇā</s>, flute, <s>mṛdaṅga</s> drum, <s>muraja</s> drum, cymbals, <s>tāla</s>, conch, banner, parasol, singing, dancing, and other [items] — with the sixteen modes of worship, O king, filled with various festivals, one should first perform five circumambulations
the <s>Buddha</s> should be sung. Parched rice and unbroken grains
flowers should be scattered upon the top of the <s>caitya</s> (shrine)

body.translated_text: Avk_P_11. O king, on the fourteenth day of the bright half of the month of <s>Āśvin</s>, one should brush the teeth

body.text: Avk_P_12. atha rājovāca / bhikṣusattama mahāprājña ahorātravrataṃ ekasthāne vā dvitīye vānye vā kim u / śāriputra uvāca /
body.translated_text: Avk_P_12. Then the king said: O best of <s>bhikṣus</s>, O greatly wise one, is the <s>Ahorātravrata</s> [to be performed] in one place, or in a second, or elsewhere? <s>Śāriputra</s> said:

children.text: yatra devālaye caitye yatra tīrthasya saṃgame /
children.translated_text: wherever there is a temple or a <s>caitya</s>, wherever there is a confluence of <s>tīrthas</s> (pilgrimage sites),
wherever there is a delightful <s>Buddhakṣetra</s> (Buddha-field) for walking meditation. ||5||

body.translated_text: Not in one place alone, O great king, but wherever a <s>caitya</s>

body.text: rājovāca / kathaṃ nātha pramāṇaṃ ca yaticaityapradakṣiṇaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ yāvat tāva

children.text: kiṃ vā / śāriputra uvāca / naiva mahārāja yatināṃ nidrā na viśrāma
children.translated_text: or what? <s>Śāriputra</s> said: Indeed, O great king, for the ascetics there is no sleep, no rest,

children.text: na dhāvitaṃ kiṃ cit ....... īdṛkpramāṇa iti /
children.translated_text: running, nothing...... such is the measure.

body.translated_text: The king said: How, O lord, [is] the measure, and how many circumambulations of the <s>caitya</s> [are required to be] complete? For how many

body.text: Avk_P_13 rājovāca / samartho 'samartho vā tasya vivekaṃ kathaya prabho / śāriputra uvāca / ke cid asamarthā vā bālavṛddhā vā ahorātravrataṃ na kartavyaṃ mahārājeti / rājovāca / kathaṃ bhikṣo mahāprājña asamarthā bālavṛddhāś ca dharmapratilabdhā bhave

children.text: / śāriputra uvāca / upavāsoṣito bhūtvā caityārcanaṃ snānādikaṃ kṛtvā japastotraṃ ca kāraye
children.translated_text: <s>Śāriputra</s> said: Having observed the fast, having performed worship at the <s>caitya</s> (shrine), bathing and other rites, one should perform recitation and hymns of praise.
For those who are unable, and again

children.text: bālānāṃ abhilāṣaṃ yadā dinam ekaṃ vā dinārdhaṃ vā praharam eka
children.translated_text: for children, when there is a desire — [they should observe] for one day, or half a day, or one watch (<s>prahara</s>),
having observed the fast, [performing] worship at the <s>caitya</s>, one, two, or three circumambulations —
according to one's ability, O great king.

body.translated_text: Avk_P_13. The king said: For the capable and the incapable, explain that distinction, O lord! <s>Śāriputra</s> said: Those who are incapable, or who are young or old — they should not perform the <s>Ahorātravrata</s>, O great king! The king said: How, O <s>bhikṣu</s>, O greatly wise one, shall the incapable, the young, and the old attain the fruits of <s>Dharma</s>?

children.translated_text: how, O <s>bhikṣu</s> (monk), is the food and eating?
the conclusion of the vow? <s>Śāriputra</s> said: Having performed purificatory bathing

children.text: dikaṃ kṛtvā cittam antargatamīkṣayet sarvaśuklopacāreṇa sugandhakusumayuktena nihatadaṇḍaśastreṇa nihataprāṇivadhena nihatādattadānena nihatakāmācāreṇa tyaktapiśunena tyaktabhinnabhāṣanena tyaktādṛṣṭavacanena tyaktapāruṣakavacanena ca na cābhidhyādhānena na ca vyāpādacittena na ca mithyādṛṣṭigrahaṇena naiva lava
children.translated_text: and other rites, one should examine one's inner mind. With all white ceremonial offerings, endowed with fragrant flowers, having abandoned weapons and staffs, having abandoned the killing of living beings, having abandoned taking what is not given, having abandoned sexual misconduct, having abandoned slander, having abandoned divisive speech, having abandoned eating food not [directly]

children.text: bhojanena naiva madyapānapipāsena naiva māṃsāhāreṇa vinā uccaśayyāṃ vinā j
children.translated_text: seen, neither drinking intoxicants, nor eating meat, without a high bed, without

children.text: ghanena vinā akālabhojanena / evaṃ mahārāja vidhim eva kartavyam / aharniśāparyante prāśanaṃ kuryā
children.translated_text: ornaments, without eating at improper times. Thus, O great king, this procedure should be followed. At the end of the day and night, one should take food.
And again, O great king, for the completion of the vow, every year
or for one year, or three,

body.translated_text: (Avk_P_14) The observance of the vow —

children.text: pūraṇāntare vicitracchattraṃ ca ..... chattraṃ ca nānopacāreṇa kusumaprarohaṇaṃ ka
children.translated_text: a variegated parasol and ... parasol with various ceremonial offerings and flower-planting should be

done. With various festive celebrations, dancing, singing, comedy, graceful dance, entertainment, the five musical tones, food at the proper time, offerings of flowers, unbroken rice, cakes, and other things thrown [as offerings], one should raise a banner.

children.text: / yathāvidhi yajñādikaṃ kṛtvā tata ācāryāya vastrānnasuvarṇakaṅkaṇādi saṃpūraṇāya / evaṃ mahārāja tata ācāryāyopādhyāyena vratinaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kuryā
children.translated_text: Having performed the sacrifice and other rites according to the proper procedure, then to the preceptor (<s>ācārya</s>) — cloth, food, gold, bracelets, and other things for the completion. Thus, O great king, then the preceptor and teacher should perform the consecration (<s>pratiṣṭhā</s>) for the auspicious benefit of the vow-observer.
Then one should perform the worship of maidens.

body.translated_text: (Avk_P_15) At the completion of the vow,
(Avk_P_16) The king said:

children.text: phalaṃ tasya kathaṃ nātha bhāṣasva tvaṃ yathāmatam // 6 //
children.translated_text: What is its fruit, O Lord? Speak according to your understanding.' (6)

body.translated_text: 'Well done, well done, O greatly wise one! The observance of the vow

children.translated_text: the fruit of this king of vows.

children.text: purā tathāgataiḥ prāha tad ekaṃ vrataśāsanam // 7 //
children.translated_text: Formerly the <s>Tathāgatas</s> proclaimed that one teaching of the vow.' (7)
